def max_bitonic_sum(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    inc = [0] * n
    dec = [0] * n
    
    inc[0] = arr[0]
    dec[n-1] = arr[n-1]
    
    for i in range(1, n):
        inc[i] = max(arr[i], inc[i-1] + arr[i] if inc[i-1] > 0 else arr[i])
        j = n - i - 1
        dec[j] = max(arr[j], dec[j+1] + arr[j] if dec[j+1] > 0 else arr[j])
    
    max_sum = 0
    for i in range(n):
        max_sum = max(max_sum, inc[i] + dec[i] - arr[i])
    
    return max_sum

def max_bitonic_sum(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    inc = [0] * n
    dec = [0] * n
    
    inc[0] = arr[0]
    dec[n-1] = arr[n-1]
    
    for i in range(1, n):
        inc[i] = max(arr[i], inc[i-1] + arr[i] if inc[i-1] > 0 else arr[i])
        j = n - i - 1
        dec[j] = max(arr[j], dec[j+1] + arr[j] if dec[j+1] > 0 else arr[j])
    
    max_sum = 0
    for i in range(n):
        max_sum = max(max_sum, inc[i] + dec[i] - arr[i])

def find_max_subarray_sum(arr, k):
    n = len(arr)
    max_kadane, min_kadane = arr[0], arr[0]
    max_sum, min_sum = arr[0], arr[0]
    
    for i in range(1, 2 * n):
        if i < n:
            max_sum += arr[i]
            min_sum += arr[i]
            max_kadane = max(max_kadane, max_sum - min_sum)
        else:
            max_sum += arr[i % n]
            min_sum += arr[i % n]
            max_kadane = max(max_kadane, max_sum - min_sum)
        
        max_kadane = max(max_kadane, arr[i % n])
        min_kadane = min(min_kadane, arr[i % n])
    
    total_sum = sum(arr)
    if total_sum > 0:
        max_kadane = max(max_kadane, total_sum * (k - 2) + max_kadane)
    
    return max_kadane

    for i in range(1, 2 * n):
        if i < n:
            max_sum += arr[i]
            min_sum += arr[i]
            max_kadane = max(max_kadane, max_sum - min_sum)
        else:
            max_sum += arr[i % n]
            min_sum += arr[i % n]
            max_kadane = max(max_kadane, max_sum - min_sum)
        
        max_kadane = max(max_kadane, arr[i % n])
        min_kadane = min(min_kadane, arr[i % n])
    
    total_sum = sum(arr)
    if total_sum > 0:
        max_kadane = max(max_kadane, total_sum * (k - 2) + max_kadane)
